paragraphs.text: Because Christ delights in his Church, he commends all that is in her.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: He has respect for the multitude of the faithful, which are many in number.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: In which are knowledge and zeal two precious jewels.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: breasts are like two young roes

paragraphs.text: Christ promises his Church to call his faithful from all the corners of the world.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Christ calls his Church sister in respect that he had taken the flesh of man.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: In that he made his Church beautiful and rich, he loved his gifts in her.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Because of your confession and thanksgiving.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: The Church confesses that all her glory and beauty comes from Christ who is the true fountain of all grace.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: She desires Christ to comfort her and to pour the graces of his Spirit on her, which is meant by the North and South wind.
paragraphs.label: i
